verses.text: <pb/>Maganar Ubangiji zuwa ga Yowel, ɗan Fetuwel.

<pb/><t>Ku dattawa, ku kasa kunne,</t> <t>Bari kowa da kowa da yake cikin</t> <t>Yahuza, ya kasa kunne.</t> <t>Wani abu mai kamar wannan ya taɓa</t> <t>faruwa a lokacinku,</t> <t>Ko a lokacin kakanninku?</t>
<t>Ku faɗa wa 'ya'yanku labarinsa,</t> <t>'Ya'yanku kuma su faɗa wa</t> <t>'ya'yansu,</t> <t>'Ya'yansu kuma su faɗa wa tsara</t> <t>mai zuwa. <pb/></t>
<t>Abin da ɗango ya bari fara ta ci,</t> <t>Abin da fara ta bari burduduwa ta</t> <t>ci.</t>
<t>Ku farka, ku yi ta kuka, ku</t> <t>bugaggu,</t> <t>Ku yi kuka, ku mashayan ruwan</t> <t>inabi,</t> <t>An lalatar da 'ya'yan inabin</t> <t>Da ake yin sabon ruwan inabi da su. <pb/></t>
<t>Rundunar ta aukar wa ƙasarmu,</t> <t>Tana da ƙarfi, ba ta kuma</t> <t>ƙidayuwa,</t> <t>Haƙoranta suna da kaifi kamar na</t> <t>zaki.</t>
<t>Ta lalatar da kurangar inabinmu,</t> <t>Ta cinye itatuwan ɓaurenmu.</t> <t>Ta gaigaye ɓawo duka,</t> <t>Saboda haka rassan sun zama fari</t> <t>fat. <pb/></t>
<t>Ya jama'a, ku yi kuka</t> <t>Kamar yarinyar da take makokin</t> <t>rasuwar saurayinta.</t>
<t>Ba hatsi ko ruwan inabin</t> <t>Da za a yi hadaya da su cikin</t> <t>Haikalin.</t> <t>Firistoci masu miƙa wa Ubangiji</t> <t>hadaya suna makoki.</t>
<t>Ba kome a gonaki,</t> <t>Ƙasa tana makoki,</t> <t>Domin an lalatar da hatsin,</t> <t>'Ya'yan inabi sun bushe,</t> <t>Itatuwan zaitun kuma sun yi yaushi.</t>
<t>Ya ku manoma, ku yi baƙin ciki,</t> <t>Ku yi kuka, ku da kuke lura da</t> <t>gonakin inabi,</t> <t>Gama alkama, da sha'ir,</t> <t>Da dukan amfanin gonaki sun</t> <t>lalace.</t>

<t>Kurangar inabi ta bushe,</t> <t>Itatuwan ɓaure kuma sun yi yaushi,</t> <t>Rumman, da dabino, da gawasa,</t> <t>Da dukan itatuwan gonaki sun</t> <t>bushe.</t> <t>Murna ta ƙare a wurin mutane. <pb/></t>

<t>Ya ku firistoci masu miƙa hadayu a</t> <t>bagaden Ubangiji,</t> <t>Ku sa tufafin makoki, ku yi kuka!</t> <t>Ku shiga Haikali, ku kwana,</t> <t>Kuna saye da tufafin makoki,</t> <t>Gama ba hatsi ko ruwan inabi da za</t> <t>a yi hadaya da su,</t> <t>A cikin Haikalin Allahnku.</t>
<t>Ku sa a yi azumi,</t> <t>Ku kira muhimmin taro.</t> <t>Ku tara dattawa da dukan mutanen</t> <t>ƙasar</t> <t>A Haikalin Ubangiji Allahnku,</t> <t>Ku yi kuka ga Ubangiji.</t>
<t>Taku ta ƙare a wannan rana!</t> <t>Gama ranar Ubangiji ta kusa,</t> <t>Halaka daga wurin Maɗaukaki ta zo. <pb/></t>
<t>An lalatar da amfanin gonaki a kan</t> <t>idonmu,</t> <t>Ba murna a Haikalin Allahnmu.</t>
<t>Itatuwa sun mutu a busasshiyar</t> <t>ƙasa,</t> <t>Ba hatsin da za a adana a rumbu,</t> <t>Rumbuna sun lalace domin ba hatsi.</t>
<t>Dabbobi suna nishi!</t> <t>Garkunan shanu sun ruɗe</t> <t>Domin ba su da makiyaya.</t> <t>Garkunan tumaki da awaki kuma</t> <t>suna shan azaba.</t>
<t>Ina kuka a gare ka, ya Ubangiji,</t> <t>Domin ciyayi da itatuwa sun bushe,</t> <t>Sai ka ce wuta ce ta ƙone su.</t>
<t>Har ma namomin jeji suna kuka a</t> <t>gare ka,</t> <t>Domin rafuffuka sun bushe,</t> <t>Ciyayi kuma sun bushe,</t> <t>Sai ka ce wuta ce ta ƙone su.</t>
